raw_text: BSNL employees are panicking after reports of a massive data breach. Management has issued internal circular asking all staff to change passwords immediately and report suspicious system activity. The breach reportedly compromised subscriber data including IMSI numbers and SIM card details. Union representatives are demanding answers about the security posture of BSNL's IT infrastructure.
